Program Risk Intelligence -- weekly update (2025-10-31)

Reply received:
"Hi -- update on CCPA: legal finalized copy and sent it over to us, Mobile, and Dealer Systems. We're starting the website updates this week for the Oct 31 date. I'd call this Medium risk mainly because we've got multiple sites to update and validate and only about a week to do it."

AI classification: BLOCKED (signal: bottlenecked)
The report date is the due date (Oct 31) itself, yet the update states website updates are only 'starting this week' after Legal just finalized copy. With multiple sites needing updates and validation, there is effectively no way to complete and validate the work by end of day, making this a missed/blocked deadline rather than merely at-risk.

This is a severe schedule compression that likely means the deadline is already missed or at extreme risk, despite the team framing it as still 'targeting' a start date.
